auth.description: Same admin_token used by Stage 1 admin endpoints

request_id.description: Unique ID of the ApprovalRequest to reject

reason.description: Optional human-readable rejection reason shown to the user

204.description: Decision recorded successfully; no response body

404.description: request_id not found in pending store

409.description: Request has already been decided or has expired

body.detail: Reservation request is no longer actionable

side_effects: Sets ApprovalRequest.decision = 'rejected', ApprovalRequest.reason = <provided reason>, ApprovalRequest.decided_at = now()
On the next user message for this session, pending_check_node delivers the rejection to the user
